entities.summary: Mustafa Sabri was an Ottoman theologian and university professor who was the penulitimate Shaykh al-Islām of the Ottoman Empire. He is known for his opinions condemning the Turkish nationalist movement under Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. Due to his resistance to Atatürk, he lived half of his life in exile in various countries, and died in Egypt.
